scope: P13 §5 — scan of product copy for country/legal/provider/production OVERCLAIMS (FR/BE/LU/CH).
method: FIXED-LEXICON ripgrep (case-insensitive, 14 phrases) across src/app + src/components + src/lib, PLUS manual classification of every hit AND an independent adversarial re-grep (review group A) over softer conformity phrasings. NOT a semantic review — a denylist scan + human classification. Honest limitation: a novel softly-worded overclaim outside the lexicon could exist; the adversarial pass found none unguarded.
method_limitation_disclosed: The scan is a denylist (14 phrases), not exhaustive semantic NLP. Two softer conformity strings live OUTSIDE the lexicon in shipped copy and are SAFE only because contextually disclaimed at point of use (see representative_matches CloneGuard entries) — not because the lexicon caught them.

classification.safe: ALL hits. No unguarded product-facing legal/country/provider/production claim exists.
